notes.title: EARLY ACCESS 2.0 RELEASE
notes.content: [p]This is one of our most exciting updates to date. We have been heads down this summer to refactor NOODS based on the community’s feedback of the app running too slow. The purpose of NOODS is to run it idle in the background as you work on your computer. We have refactored it for Windows to run much faster, fix memory leak issues, plus a whole swath of bug fixes. We still have many more bugs to go, some tricky ones as well.[/p][p]This summer, we’ve been heads-down making NOODS faster, smoother, and ready for long idle runs while you work or game. Thanks to your feedback, we tracked down the slowdown issues and gave our Windows build a full refactor.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve still got some tricky bugs to tackle, but this update is a huge leap forward.[/p][p]Next up, we’re diving into two of the [b]most requested community features[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Blocklist Mode:[/b] time-limit specific websites and apps[/p][/*][*][p][b]MacOS Version:[/b] long-awaited and finally in the works[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us while we make NOODS the perfect desktop companion. Keep the feedback coming, it’s powering every update![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]✨[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Runs much faster on Windows[/p][/*][*][p]Memory leak fixes for better long-term performance[/p][/*][*][p]A whole swarm of bug fixes squashed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🔨[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lily incorrect window interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled window interaction system, now performs faster and better![/p][/*][*][p]Made window interaction system multi-platform compatible[/p][/*][*][p]Full screen grabbing (currently work-in-progress)[/p][/*][*][p]Destroy target (shifting screen; currently work-in-progress)[/p][/*][*][p]NOODS multi-threading makes it be recognized as a background process (go to task manager to exit) [/p][/*][*][p]Memory leak (currently work-in-progress in refactor)[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue timing and freezing[/p][/*][*][p]Thrown window getting minimized and then can not return[/p][/*][*][p]Particular window issues found on Windows 10[/p][/*][*][p]Issues with asset loading fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements regarding playing or not playing for certain time periods are working again[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🐝[b]Known Bugs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Certain Lily interactions will sometimes ignore the volume setting (if this happens, please send a bug report with what she was doing at the time!)[/p][/*][*][p]Streak achievements may not get awarded at the right time[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]😘[b]Requests:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Let us know how the refactored v2.0 is running on your computer![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]📢[b]Community Shout-Outs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Thanks for checking us out at OpenSauce in San Francisco Bay Area last month[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1 First Early Access Patch
notes.content:
[u][b]Build v1.0.1 - Early Access [/b][/u]
Thank you to the community for our first set of bug reports and feedback. We are loving all the feedback so please keep it coming. This update contains a mix of minor UI updates and bug fixes.

✨[b]What’s New:[/b]
-Added additional UI buttons in internal menus to streamline UX (inbox, help screen)
-Gave Lily some Mountain Dew… we’ll see how that pans out
-New easter egg dialogue

🔨[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]
-Checklist formatting issues; gussied up the tier system
-Visual fixes in UI; moving pixels around so they’re prettier
-exe icon 
-Pomodoro timer pause number formatting
-Asset loading
-Log file handling

🐝[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
-Checklist inserting lines between existing lines
-Memory leak (currently work-in-progress)
-Destroy target
-Full screen grabbing (currently work-in-progress)
-Home menu hiding offscreen on certain users

😘[b]Requests:[/b]
-Report any new bugs you see with our handy-dandy bug reporting button 
-Send NOODS to everyone you know

📢[b]Community Shout-Outs:[/b]
-Cuten00b is getting the word out about NOODS! What a star! 💫
-Shout out on reporting the memory leak issue on Steam!

notes.title: NOODS out on Early Access!
notes.content:
[b] Build v1.0.0 - Early Access Launch[/b]

Welcome to NOODS!

Our chaotic desktop critters have officially hit Steam, and you're invited to the shenanigans. This is the first public early access build of NOODS for Windows— we’re thrilled to have you here to mess up (and maybe even organize) your desktop with us.

[b]🌟 What’s New:[/b]
Literally everything.
You’re here at the very beginning, which means your feedback is pure gold to us. We’ve built the bones of NOODS to bring joy, nostalgia, and a tiny bit of mayhem to your daily flow.

[b]Here’s what’s included:[/b]
[list]
[*]     ✅ To-do checklists
[*]     ⏲️ Pomodoro timer & stopwatch
[*]     🔔 Alarms & reminders
[*]     📸 Screenshot & selfie system
[*]     💥 Window destruction (in-progress chaos)
[*]     🦝 Lily the raccoon’s debut desktop takeover
[*]     🔊 Original audio & pixel FX
[*]     🎮 Hidden minigame(s)
[*]     ⚙️ Settings & feedback/report tools
[/list]

[b]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/b]
None yet — you’re on the frontier!
Help us squash the weird stuff by using the Report Bug button on the home menu.

[b]🐞 Known Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding checklist items formatting
[*] ”Destroy” feature is still work-in-progress; would like feedback on this
[*] Throwing windows animations
[/list]

[b]💌 Your Feedback Matters:[/b]
Fill out this form to drop your thoughts, dreams, and ideas:
[url=https://glossbird.notion.site/19ac0b5235b7806b834ecf0a6345007a]NOODS Feedback Form[/url]
Let’s make this the weirdest productivity app to ever exist — together.

Thanks for noodling with us 💖
— The Glossbird Team
